test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

PIN ∶ VAX ∶∶ RBX ∶ ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First alphabet is increased to 6 positional values.**
 
• Second alphabet is decreased to 8 positional values.
 
• Third alphabet is increased to 10 positional values.

​ **PIN becomes VAX** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a52586820cb5e0d33aee0a5cac4b5978b15e980983351897e6507434e14dd918.png] 

Similarly,

 **RBX becomes XTH** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05311c5963334308a7ccc1648ce48fe3b60232c6895f748b989fdf73e063fc52.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
